signedOut.title: Sign in to Agent X
signedOut.body: Agent X lets your AI agents pay approved suppliers within limits your team sets. Sign in with your work account and passkey.
signedOut.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
choose.title: Choose an organisation
choose.body: You belong to more than one. You can switch at any time from the top of the page.
choose.unreadable: One of your organisations can't be opened right now: its records failed Agent X's integrity check. It opens again once that is resolved.
none.title: You're not in an organisation yet
none.body: Ask an admin of your organisation to invite you. Once you accept, it appears here.
frozen.banner: This organisation is frozen. No agent can spend until an admin unfreezes it.
soon.payments: Every payment and its timeline will appear here.
soon.agents: Your organisation's agents and their keys will appear here.
more.title: More
more.signOutFailed: You're still signed in: Agent X couldn't sign you out just now. Try again, or close every window of this browser.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Agent X couldn't load this page. Try again in a moment.
notFound.title: Page not found
confirm.choose: Choose what happens. Nothing is chosen for you.
confirm.unloaded: Agent X couldn't load what this change does, so it can't be confirmed yet. Try again in a moment.
stepUp.title: You've signed in again. Confirm the change
stepUp.refused: Agent X didn't make this change: {change}. Its confirmation was refused or ran out. Ask for it again if you still want it.
stepUp.failed: Agent X couldn't be reached, so the change isn't made yet. Try confirming again.
stepUp.lost: A change you signed in again for can't be found in this window, so it wasn't made. Ask for it again if you still want it.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.noneAll: No AI agent has asked to pay anyone yet.
approvals.unchecked: {count} request(s) can't be shown: their records failed Agent X's integrity check. Agent X has raised the alarm; they show again once it is resolved.
request.recheck: The supplier's details changed after this request was decided and were verified again. Approving checks it again under the new details.
request.fine: Approving and rejecting ask for your passkey. The amount, supplier and invoice can't change after you approve.
request.viewOnly: Only an admin or an approver can approve, reject or cancel a request.
request.notFound: This request can't be found in this organisation. If its email named another organisation, switch to it from the top of the page.
request.rejectText: Rejecting ends this request: nothing is paid, and the money held for it is freed at once. Your reason is kept on record for your team, and is never shown to the agent.
request.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing will be paid for this request.
request.refused.REQUEST_NOT_WAITING: This request is no longer waiting for approval: someone approved, rejected or cancelled it, or it expired. Its page now shows where it stands.
request.refused.REQUEST_EXPIRED: This request waited as long as your organisation allows, so it expired and can't be approved. The agent must ask again.
request.refused.REQUEST_CHANGED: Something this request was decided on has changed since (its mandate, supplier, bank account, agent or key), so it can't be approved as it is. Reject it, and the agent can ask again.
request.refused.ADMIN_APPROVAL_ONLY: This request is over its mandate's own limits, so only an admin can approve it.
request.refused.REQUEST_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This request has ended or is already with the bank, so it can no longer be cancelled.
request.refused.ORG_FROZEN: This organisation is frozen, so nothing can be approved until an admin unfreezes it. Rejecting and cancelling still work.
request.refused.FORBIDDEN: Your role in this organisation can't do this. Ask an admin.
request.refused.other: Agent X didn't make this change (reason {code}). Nothing was changed.
request.failed: Agent X couldn't be reached, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
